# telnyx_country_coverage_country (Data Source)

The phone number features Telnyx offers in one country.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "telnyx_country_coverage_country" "germany" {
  country_code = "DE"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `country_code` (String) The country code.

### Read-Only

- `code` (String) Country ISO code
- `features` (List of String) Set of features supported
- `international_sms` (Boolean)
- `inventory_coverage` (Boolean) Indicates whether country can be queried with inventory coverage endpoint
- `local` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--local))
- `mobile` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `national` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `numbers` (Boolean)
- `p2p` (Boolean)
- `phone_number_type` (List of String) Phone number type
- `quickship` (Boolean) Supports quickship
- `region` (String) Geographic region (e.g., AMER, EMEA, APAC)
- `reservable` (Boolean) Supports reservable
- `shared_cost` (String) A JSON document; use `jsondecode()` to read it.
- `toll_free` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--toll_free))
